results.title: AP PGECET Exam 2026 - Admit Card, Date, Syllabus, Answer Key ...
results.content: AP PGECET or Andhra Pradesh Post Graduate Engineering Common Entrance Test is a state entrance exam conducted by Andhra University, Visakhapatnam. Candidates have to submit the following information while filling out the AP PGECET 2026 application form: payment reference ID, qualifying examination hall ticket number, mobile number, and date of birth. Candidates can download AP PGECET Sample/Question Papers from here. **Domicile –**The candidates applying for the AP PGECET exam 2026 should be permanent residents of Andhra Pradesh or Telangana. The candidates have to carry the AP PGECET admit card 2026 on exam day. The minimum marks required by candidates for PG admissions in Andhra Pradesh will be present in the AP PGECET cutoff of 2026. Candidates will be able to download the AP PGECET 2026 hall ticket on the official website. APSCHE conducts postgraduate admissions in Andhra Pradesh state for AP PGECET qualified candidates, apart from GATE/GPAT-qualified ones.
